title: SPRINT ABM - Zero to Mach 10 in 5 Seconds!
summary: A short clip of the Sprint anti-ballistic missile, which was launched from a silo and reached Mach 10 within seconds. Its nose and skin glow white hot from aerodynamic heating.
why: HN links it as striking footage of how fast and heat-stressed hypersonic interceptors and ICBM re-entry vehicles are.

quote.text: Here is a US missile maneuvering at mach 10 to intercept a RV going at mach 30. In 1972.
